verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a genuine self-host option ('runs on your own hardware... single self-contained binary', 'local graph engine, local embeddings, local LLM') but explicitly state 'No Docker. No database to provision... It boots in seconds' — the opposite of the Docker-based deployment implied by the story, and there is no confirmation the self-host binary is distributed as open-source code (the GitHub repo evidence is for the hosted product, not shown to be the self-host artifact). missing for 10: explicit open-source license/repo for the self-host binary, Docker/container deployment instructions, and independent confirmation of a working self-hosted deployment.
